replies.author: imryaan
replies.body:
Eh

Void in TDM isn't really the best idea.
Way too small meaning there is hardly any pvp space, I would suggest adding more area to pvp.
Spice up the ground as it looks quite bland (by this I mean add random course dirt or podzol etc).
Move the arrow spawner somewhere else as having it right next to spawn could mean someone can just camp it the whole time.
